productArea.name: Repository code
productArea.scope: Browse repository trees, files, branches, tags, history, and diffs, search code with text or regex, find files, download archives, and create, edit, upload, or patch files with commit signoff. Pull request reviews, releases, repository policies, and Actions are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Code in the seeded repository and use the tree, file views, branch selector, history, file finder, and editing controls.
Choose Branches to inspect branch search and available branch actions.
Open the main branch commit history and select a commit to inspect its diff.
Use the repository code search field and its search options.
Choose Explore then Code to search across repositories when code indexing is available.
Choose Code on the user profile to search that owner's repositories. Organization profiles offer the same Code search.
